notes: The catalog text (and source URL) is the page for 'Woodworking Manufacturing Technologies (CERT)', the general certificate, not 'Woodworking Manufacturing Technologies: Cabinetmaking (CERT)'. The Cabinetmaking certificate is listed separately in the page navigation but its requirements are not printed in the text, so no blocks, total or outcomes are recorded for it.
section_heading records the only program section printed on the page; it is a different award and its requirements were deliberately not recorded as this award's.

The general certificate section prints a core list (WMT 101, WMT 102 or 103 or 171A or 171B, WMT 107, WMT 118, WMT 151 or 153 or 171B; subtotal 15-20), a choose-4-units elective list, Total Units 19-24, and three Program Student Learning Outcomes. A reviewer should fetch the Cabinetmaking (CERT) page (likely .../woodworking-manufacturing-technologies-cabinetmaking-certificate-achievement/) to record this award.
